# Tier 2: Tenant Scoped Dynamic Branding Endpoint
@router.get("/api/v1/tenant/branding", response_model=TenantBrandingResponse)
def get_tenant_branding(
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    tenant_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
):
    """Resolves visual identity from Host subdomain or headers."""
    org, branding = _resolve_tenant_entity(db, request, tenant_id)
    return TenantBrandingResponse(
        tenant_id=org.id,
        brand_name=branding.brand_name,
        primary_color=branding.primary_color,
        accent_color=branding.accent_color,
        logo_url=branding.logo_url,
    )
